content.short: Solidity is the most widely used language for writing EVM compatible smart contracts.
content.description: Solidity, proposed in August 2014 by the Ethereum Foundation as the first smart contract programming language, established a foundation for programmable contracts. Its syntax and inheritance reflect influences from C++, Python, and JavaScript, enabling developers to model complex relationships and automate on-chain behavior. Today, there is a large online community of Solidity developers and a wealth of compatible tools and libraries that support writing, testing, and deploying contracts. In total, more than 8 million Solidity contracts have been deployed.
